    End H →⋆ₐ[ℂ] EndC (bocaDefectOffHeadTensor phi hphi rhoDefect x)

    The concrete head-factor left action currently exposed by the committed interior-tensor API. This is genuinely head \otimes id_tail, but its source algebra is End H, because bocaDefectCorr x was built as a CorrEndBimod H H from rhoDefect : End H -> End K_x^o.
